content_data.meeting_title: Strategic Review: Regional Grid Modernization Initiative
agenda_items: Review of current initiative progress and milestones
Identification of next-phase priorities and resource allocation
key_decisions: Form a dedicated task force to address inter-agency regulatory compliance, reporting back in 2 weeks.
Allocate additional budget for pilot testing of advanced sensor technologies in two key substations.
attendees: Mr. Kenji Tanaka (Senior Regulatory Advisor, EnergyCo)
Ms. Vivian Lee (Head of Regional Operations, EnergyCo)
Mr. Ricardo Mendez (VP of Infrastructure Development, EnergyCo)
